title: The Future of Transportation Starts Now | David Neeleman
summary: David Neeleman, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Breeze Airways and founder of JetBlue and Azul, explains why Seagliders caught his attention.
body_markdown: At REGENT's Demo Day factory opening ceremony on Sept. 30, 2026, David Neeleman, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Breeze Airways and founder of JetBlue and Azul, explains why Seagliders caught his attention. He covers flying in ground effect, why coastal travel is such a big opportunity, and his idea for putting Seagliders into daily operation in Rhode Island.
